body: Vinit Teredesai (CFO) on 2025-07-23 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "We have mentioned in the past that it needs to be improved by 200-300 basis point by the time we reach FY27. If you look at our last year, it was 14.7." Metric: EBIT margin (company). Target: +200-300 bp vs FY25 14.7% (16.7-17.7%). Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-22: pending. Evidence: FY26 15.6% (+90 bp); Q1FY27 ~16.0% (derived from Q2's +1.6% QoQ EBIT on +8.4% QoQ INR revenue), Q2FY27 15.0% (wage hike, large-deal amortisation). GOALPOST FLAG: 2026-01-20 'we are not aspiring now to take it another 200 basis points up'; 2026-04-21 'we have achieved whatever we had said ... Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range' - the floor moved from 16.7% to 16% without acknowledging it. Scored at FY27 on the expansion promised (clarification B).
